recorded_from: Sonarr 4.0.20.3014, testing its Braid download client (Radarr's own request is byte-identical apart from the category name: movies-radarr, sent under the same field name, category, not movieCategory)
note: Sonarr's own settings screen calls this field tvCategory and Radarr's calls it movieCategory, but that is only each app's local field name for its own schema: on the wire both send the same qBittorrent form field, category, with no savePath at all. See sonarr_adds_a_magnet_with_a_category_and_no_save_path.json and harness/README.md for why an empty save path used to break every add.
